topic: The identity of the world's highest mountain above sea level
core_question: What is the highest mountain in the world above sea level?
answer_summary: The answer is Mount Everest (locally called Sagarmatha in Nepali or Chomolungma in Tibetan), the mountain with the highest elevation above sea level (about 8,849 m / 29,032 ft), located on the Nepal-China (Tibet) border in the Himalayas.
persona: anxious and rambling; writing in full careful sentences

I don't know, maybe the Himalayas? Just give me the answer please, I really need this.
